purpose: Human passage-backed adjudication; not an automated clinical accuracy score.

support_verdicts.supported: Material claims and limitations follow from the scoped frozen evidence; required population/product/comparator/timeframe qualifiers are preserved; answer addresses the actual question.
support_verdicts.partially_supported: Main conclusion has support but a qualifier, source attribution, requested detail or coherent follow-up coverage is missing or overstated. Record critical errors separately even if the main conclusion is supported.
support_verdicts.unsupported: A material conclusion, number, causal claim, safety statement or recommendation lacks support, contradicts the source, or claims evidence outside the frozen source scope.

critical_error_categories.wrong_product: Combination, ingredient, formulation, monotherapy or add-on evidence generalized to a different product or therapy setting.
critical_error_categories.wrong_population: Incorrect eligibility, age floor, disease population or invented exclusions; especially age >=10 generalized to all children.
critical_error_categories.wrong_number_comparator: Wrong magnitude, unit, denominator, direction, endpoint, comparator, group difference or observation window; within-group and between-group results confused.
critical_error_categories.unsafe_personal_recommendation: Personal start/stop/dose/switch instruction or individualized safety conclusion beyond research-evidence scope.
critical_error_categories.invented_adverse_event_frequency: Rare/common or numeric frequency asserted where spontaneous reports cannot estimate frequency; reporting counts treated as incidence.
critical_error_categories.incorrect_absence_scope: Not established becomes not measured; not listed becomes definitely not measured; no available evidence becomes proof of no effect; protocol becomes completed result.
critical_error_categories.unsupported_claim: Other material invented assertion. Explain why it is critical rather than merely irrelevant wording.

rules: Inspect answer text and uncertainty/limitations together.
Do not count citation syntax or model self-revision as claim-level entailment.
Adjudicate synthetic sources as controls and preserve demo disclosure, never as real clinical evidence.
Keep all failed examples and never replace retained historical outputs.
Guard, busy and fallback outcomes are labeled separately from completed local two-pass generations.
Mark unreviewed outputs explicitly; never infer supported from a successful HTTP response.
